column3: “Want you to know” replaces make known.
“Not only” supplies only; because it was renders through.
“Inspired” supplies a verb for the love from us in you; “of giving” is supplied.
“Give” specifies do; “were the first” renders began before.
“As you began” specifies readiness to will.
“Not only” expands indeed; went out is rendered “is ... coming.”
“Hope” is supplied; abundance is specified as a generous gift.
Glory of Christ is rendered “to the glory of Christ.”
